title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 47 (Saturna Island East End)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Saturna Island East End
47 That portion of Saturna Island in M.U. 1-01 which lies easterly of the west side of Fiddler Road and the northerly and southerly prolongations thereof and is contained within the mean low water mark of that portion of Saturna Island. [en. B.C. Reg. 224/92, s. 3.]
